name: Rhinag
summary: Rhinag is an afflicted jungle troll of the Darkspear tribe, sheltering among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border. Weakened by the harsh venom of the region's scorpids, he relies entirely on passing travelers to secure him a timely remedy.

sections.title: A Venomous Peril
sections.body: While traversing the arid terrain of Durotar, Rhinag fell victim to the vicious sting of a local Venomtail Scorpid. Overwhelmed by the potent poison, he took shelter among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border. Weakened and isolated, his survival hinges on anyone who happens by with the resolve to procure a venomtail antidote before the toxins take their final toll.

faq.answer: Rhinag is a jungle troll traveler who found himself stranded and weakened near Durotar's northwestern border after suffering a venomous sting from a native scorpion.
He is resting among the rocks near the northwestern border of Durotar.

While traversing the plains of Durotar, Rhinag was stung by a dangerous Venomtail Scorpid. The virulent toxin left him incapacitated, requiring an antidote to neutralize the poison before it proves fatal.

angles.text: Finding a kinsman struck down by native wildlife in the arid wastes of Durotar is a stark reminder of the trials the Darkspear tribe faces in carving out a home alongside the Horde.
